title: Map makes a new list

blocks.md:
## map does not rewrite the original

`names.map(n => n.toUpperCase())` returns a **new** array of the same length, with each item transformed. The list you started from is untouched — that is the whole point, and the hidden test checks it.

Here you map two lowercase names to uppercase and join them: `ADA,GRACE`.

blocks.promptMd: > Map `ada, grace` to uppercase and join with a comma: `ADA,GRACE`.

hintLadder.md: The starter joins the names but never changes them, so the letters stay lowercase.
`map` builds a new list from the old one; `join` turns that new list into text.
`["a"].map((s) => s.toUpperCase())` is `["A"]`, and the original list is untouched.

description: Make a new list from an old one. The original stays put.
